resources.string: Solarchik Assistant runs on Solana mainnet with real funds, so it uses your own wallet app through Mobile Wallet Adapter: Seed Vault on Seeker, or Phantom / Solflare. The app never holds your keys and every transaction opens in the wallet for your approval.
Real funds. Every transaction opens in your wallet app for approval.
Developer mode: devnet test SOL, built-in test wallet allowed.
For testing only. Devnet SOL has no value; switching drops the wallet session.
Connect your wallet app (Seed Vault, Phantom or Solflare). Reading balances never signs anything.
No Solana wallet app found. Mainnet needs your own wallet: Seed Vault on Seeker, or Phantom / Solflare.
Solana mainnet: real SOL and tokens. Nothing moves without your approval in the wallet.
No wallet connected. Connect your wallet app and Sol can prepare real Solana mainnet actions for you; each one waits for your approval in the wallet.
Agent NFTs on mainnet open once the Solarchik collection is live. All three agents work now without an NFT.
Today\'s check-in is a real mainnet transaction.
You made a real swap on mainnet today.
Your check-in is signed, but not as a mainnet transaction, so this item stays open.
Counts only a real mainnet transaction you approved today: the check-in memo (about 0.000005 SOL network fee) or a swap. Nothing is repeated for you.
You made a real swap today.
Your check-in is signed but wasn\'t a mainnet transaction.
Swap SOL, USDC, SKR and JUP at Jupiter\'s best route. The app prepares the swap and shows the quote, price impact and fees; your wallet app asks you to approve it. Nothing is signed automatically.
Developer devnet mode is on. Real swaps run on mainnet only; paper agents still work.

Swaps use real tokens on Solana mainnet and can\'t be undone. Prices move; you can lose value. Limits you control: a daily spend cap (default %1$s SOL), max slippage (default %2$s), and only these tokens: %3$s. Every swap needs your approval in the wallet. Not financial advice.
Turn on real swaps? Swaps spend real SOL or tokens on Solana mainnet and can\'t be reversed. The app never signs for you, and stays within your daily cap and slippage limit.
I understand, turn on real swaps
Allowed tokens: %1$s. Routes moving the price more than %2$s%% are refused.
Your wallet app shows this transaction next. Approve only if it matches. The app checks the transaction is paid and signed only by your wallet.
Swap failed on chain; it no longer counts toward your cap
Swap sent; confirmation is taking a while. Check Solscan.
Once a day it prepares one small buy with SOL. You review and approve it in your wallet, or skip it.
Paper agents (simulated money) keep running in Desk.
Jupiter didn\'t answer right now. Nothing was sent.
Real swaps run on mainnet only.

That would go over today\'s cap.
Price impact is too high for this amount.
The quote didn\'t match the request.
